_meta.note: World Bank values copied verbatim from API via WebFetch extraction (one URL per indicator). Everything else sourced inline. Null/missing years omitted. Compiled by a data-collection agent; no values invented; not found items listed in 'not_found'.

_notes.SE.XPD.TOTL.GB.ZS: 1982, 1983, 1986 values are 0 in the API: almost certainly missing-data artefacts, not true zeros; do not use.
_notes.SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS: Government expenditure on education, % of GDP. Compare PIDS/World Bank basic-education-only figures (2.2-3.6% 2010-2019) which differ in coverage.
_notes.SE.COM.DURS: Compulsory education duration, years (WB/UIS). 10 through 2011; 11 in 2012-2017 (kindergarten compulsory from RA 10157, +6 elementary +4 JHS); 13 from 2018 (+2 SHS). Year of step (2018) reflects UIS coding lag vs law (SHS Grade 11 began SY2016-17).
_notes.SE.PRM.TCHR: Primary school teachers, headcount. 2013-2017 and secondary series show breaks around the 2016-2018 SHS transition (SE.SEC.TCHR rises 267,515 (2014) -> 421,824 (2018) as SHS teachers added).
_notes.SE.XPD.PRIM.PC.ZS: % of government education expenditure going to primary. Last obs 2008. SE.XPD.SECO.PC.ZS last 2008; SE.XPD.TERT.PC.ZS last 2009.

laws_and_policies.name: Commonwealth Act 586 (Education Act of 1940)
laws_and_policies.content: Revision of system of public elementary education incl. financing; compulsory attendance ages/grades not found in extract

laws_and_policies.name: RA 10157 Kindergarten Education Act
laws_and_policies.date: 20 Jan 2012 (per lawyerly.ph title 'REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10157, January 20, 2012')
laws_and_policies.content: 'kindergarten education shall be made mandatory and compulsory for entrance to Grade 1'

laws_and_policies.name: RA 10533 Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013
laws_and_policies.content: At least 1 year kindergarten + 6 years elementary + 6 years secondary (4 JHS + 2 SHS). Elementary and secondary described as stages of 'compulsory basic education'. Text does not say '12 years' literally. Declares quality education 'globally competitive'/'at par with international standards'.

laws_and_policies.name: RA 10931 Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (free tuition in SUCs/LUCs)
laws_and_policies.content: Free tuition/fees in SUCs and LUCs; later effects: CHED chair reported enrolment 2.9M (2017) -> 4.1M (2022); shift from private to public

laws_and_policies.name: CSC Resolution No. 2500229 (qualification standards)
laws_and_policies.content: SHS graduates eligible for first-level government positions that previously required at least 2 years of college; JHS grads eligible for positions formerly requiring pre-2016 HS diploma. Illustrates credential-reward rule linking K-12 to public employment.

laws_and_policies.name: Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps)
laws_and_policies.content: Conditional cash transfer; children 0-14 targeted 2013, 0-18 from 2014/2015; school attendance is a condition

pantawid_4ps_households._reliability: Point values only; annual series 2009-2011, 2013, 2015-2017 not found in extractable text (exists as chart/figures).
